articles.summary: ORLANDO, Fla., Oct. 27, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Nutriband Inc. (NASDAQ:NTRB)(NASDAQ:NTRBW) has announced that Company founder, Gareth Sheridan has returned as Company CEO.During the period of August 10 until October 27 , Co-Founder and Chairman, Serguei Melnik had taken over the responsibilities of CEO.
